svg.title: RoomMesh Platform Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-End Multi-Room Environmental Telemetry Pipeline and Edge Intelligence Architecture

g.text: Multi-Room Edge Telemetry Pipeline • Secure MQTT Transport • oneM2M Semantic Model • Comparative Observability
Auto-generates oneM2M AEs & InfluxDB time-series tags
Plug-and-play extension without code changes or stack redesign
SECURE TELEMETRY TRANSPORT: MQTT OVER TLS / mTLS (PORT 8883)
Client Certificate Verification • Topic-Level ACL Authorization • Deterministic JSON Telemetry Schema
